{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check if any QA orders are in completed status
qa_completed = qa_orders[qa_orders['status'] == 'completed']
print(f"Number of QA orders that are completed: {len(qa_completed)}")

# Check their customer_segment
print("QA orders by customer_segment:\n", qa_completed['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Filter to only completed orders
completed_only = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute conversion rate by segment on completed orders only
conversion_by_segment = completed_only.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()
print("Conversion rate by segment (completed only):\n", conversion_by_segment)

# Find the segment with the highest rate
best_segment = conversion_by_segment.idxmax()
print(f"Highest conversion rate segment: {best_segment}")"}
